title: Deja Blue | KEY.co
description_expanded: Crafted for connection and built for unforgettable gatherings, this pet-friendly vacation retreat redefines the group getaway experience with a private pool, rooftop bar, and a full suite of resort-style amenities. Located just minutes from the beach, this sprawling home comfortably accommodates up to 26 guests across eight bedrooms and multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces. From the moment guests step into the billiard room and out to the poolside pavilion, they’re greeted by endless entertainment—swim-up bar, hot tub, sand volleyball court, fire pit, putting green, and a rooftop lounge with grill and fireplace for sunset cocktails. Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive.
